result:
Enrichment pass complete.

**Edits made (3 records):**
- `objectives/engine-coherence-enables-gamification-enables-ops.md` — removed invented `goal:` frontmatter key whose value was duplicated verbatim in body; stripped "**Action:**"/"**Why:**" stub labels.
- `plans/fars-core-extraction.md` — stripped `## Overview` subsection duplicating title + `goal:` frontmatter.
- `plans/micromodel-training-pipeline.md` — stripped `## Summary` stub; replaced `## Sources` (duplicating `sources:` frontmatter) with shorter `## See also` retaining only links not in frontmatter.

All three verified to parse cleanly.

**Key finding:** the record set is editorially healthy. Most prose is load-bearing — captain directives, math grounding, trade-off analyses. Cruft patterns (`## Overview`, `## Summary`, `## Next Steps`, dated log sections) are rare in active records. The expected prose → frontmatter promotion was minimal because the work has already been done under captain's accretion policies.

**Flagged for captain (in report):**
- ~10 invented frontmatter keys present across records (`priority:`, `source-directive:`, `closes-when:`, `completed-tasks:`, `revised:`, micromodel parameter keys, etc.) carrying real information but not in authoritative schemas — need schema-formalization decisions
- Two inconsistent `milestones:` shapes (`{id,title,conditions,gate}` vs. `{name,tasks,criteria}`)

Report at `operations/command/endeavor/records/analyses/prose-to-encoding-enrichment-report.md`.
